movement.t: 29 Jun: Top 16.5% on likes, its best week on file.
movement.s: Aneet & collabs went from 4% of May's posts to 29% of June's and July's. Followers ran +15.7K a week from 8 Jun to 19 Jul.

movement.t: 7 Sep: 21 posts, Top 80%. The worst week on file.
movement.s: Events, trend riffs and skincare, with one famous face all week.

movement.t: 12 Oct: 53 posts, 45 of them event posts. Top 45%.
movement.s: Fashion Week went up in bulk. The week after, 16 posts landed Top 28%.

streaks.t: Events ended 3 of its 10 hot stretches, the most of any slice.
streaks.s: A stretch counts once, even when it ran on likes and comments too. Lips & cheeks 2, skincare 2, trend riffs 2.

streaks.t: 17 Oct: 8 in a row below the middle, all posted that day.
streaks.s: Typical Top 91%. Fashion Week's busiest day: 15 posts, 13 of them events.

slices.Events: With a famous face Top 8% (9 posts); studio shots of the looks Top 87%. 55 in October.
slices.Lips & cheeks: Half the feed in July and August, landing Top 36% then 74%. Two posts in October. Carousels land Top 46%, reels Top 69%.
slices.Skincare: Top 60%, steady since April. Graphic-heavy skincare lands Top 72%.
slices.Eyes & base: Someone facing the camera: Top 76% (13 posts). The rest: Top 57%.
slices.Aneet & collabs: Top 12%. 20 of the feed's top-10% posts.
slices.Trend riffs: None reached the top 10%. None in October.
slices.Teasers: Mid. Six in October, landing Top 40%.

followers.t: Lakmē's posts don't move its followers.
followers.s: +4,126 in 48h after a Top 5% post, +4,843 after the rest. Shuffled, that's chance.

followers.t: The biggest days fell where we have no posts.
followers.s: 1–5 Aug: +8.5K to +14.3K a day, with no posts on file from 18 Jul to 17 Aug.
Swarovski lost 76.8K the same week, so it looks like an Instagram-wide cleanup, not the feed.

followers.t: 30 Sep – 14 Oct: −10K, every tracked day down.
followers.s: Through the 5 PM Reset posts. It turned once Fashion Week started.

stories.line: Beauty brand: launches, Fashion Week, and Aneet Padda as the face.
stories.why: About 17 posts a week since April. Events, lips & cheeks, skincare, eyes & base and Aneet with creator collabs, in near-equal parts. The smallest of the five, Aneet's, does the most.
stories.key: Every × on this page is against its usual post lately: 409 likes, 11 comments, 62.4K plays. This page reads likes: its overall rank leans on a follower count that's wrong for 57 posts.

stories.unit: its usual likes · its 11 posts with a famous face this week
stories.why: Aneet's runway walk for Amit Aggarwal on Monday: 39.3K likes. Aditya Madiraju eating Delhi snacks between lip questions: 17.2K. The five posts without a face people know came in at 0.8×.
stories.so: Lakmē knows it: 11 of its 16 posts this week had one.

stories.unit: its usual likes · Aneet's Ice Ceramide reel, 24 Oct
stories.line: Aneet launched a lip balm and it beat everything else this month.
stories.why: 56 seconds of Aneet and the new balm: raspberries and ice, the metallic applicator, a line on the formula, then two more shades. 43.5K likes, one for every 33 plays.
stories.so: Face, balm, swatch. Nothing else in the frame.

stories.unit: its usual likes · the strobe cream demo, 24 Oct
stories.line: Same day, a model sold strobe cream to the lens: 142 likes.
stories.why: She dots it on her cheek and smiles into the camera, and that's the post. Across 20 eyes & base posts where a model faces the camera, the typical one did 0.5× its usual.
stories.so: On Aneet a product gets a moment. Held up by a model, it's a catalogue page.

stories.unit: plays turned into a like · the balm on a model, 25 Oct
stories.line: Same balm the next day, on a model: 160K plays, 409 likes.
stories.why: Same product, same week. Aneet's version got a like for every 33 plays; this one, one for every 392. Its reels usually need about 277.
stories.so: The balm didn't change. The face did.

stories.unit: its usual likes · its 4 carousels this week
stories.line: All four carousels were Fashion Week, and they beat the reels.

rows.note: 5 Aneet & collabs, 3 events, 2 skincare, 2 eyes & base
All from Fashion Week, 3 with a famous face
None this week

stories.why: Its reels with play counts drew about 64K plays each, a little over the 55K its other reels got since mid-October. One took 1.4M.

stories.unit: posts this week · usual 17 · last week 53
stories.line: Fashion Week ended Monday. Then about two a day.
stories.why: Monday's six were the finale, Aneet's walk among them. Nothing went up on Thursday.
stories.so: Coming down from 53 is just the show ending, and the posts got better for it.

stories.unit: followers this week · 17th of 29 weeks on file
stories.line: Up every day. Steady, nothing dramatic.
stories.why: The finale on Monday was the best day, +2,692. The balm launch day brought +1,047.
stories.so: Healthy, and nowhere near the summer, when Aneet ran most weeks and it gained +15.7K a week.

stories.unit: posts this week beat its usual likes
stories.line: Its best week since June, and Aneet is the reason again.

reviews.s: Aneet and the new balm, 56 seconds. The runaway.
Aditya Madiraju eating his way through lip questions. 17.2K likes.
A model selling it to the lens. 142 likes.

stories.so: Lakmē's ceiling is still Aneet. Aditya's snack reel is the only other post near it.

stories.unit: calls for next week, checked next Tuesday
stories.line: Feeder Reader's calls, if the feed stays like this.

rows.why: Eyes & base posts like that have done 0.5× since April.

slices:Aneet & collabs.what: Lakmē's Fashion Week faces: Aneet Padda as the Skin Goals Officer, her glam team's touch-up, and creators Aditya Madiraju and Ankush Bahuguna doing booth chats and snack vlogs.
slices:Aneet & collabs.why: Aneet doing a bit with a product wins: the Skin Goals Officer CC cream rescue, the five-second glam team chaos. Aditya's Delhi snack lip reel lands too. Ankush's booth Q&A, elevator touch-up and Bollywood skit all sit under half.

slices:Lips & cheeks.what: Two caption-led festive lip posts from the same day: a dry-lips reset reel and a glossy pout carousel, both product shots with no one clearly on screen.
slices:Lips & cheeks.why: Only two posts, and the reel sits above the carousel on the same day. Neither has a face or a bit, so there is nothing here to separate strong from weak.

slices:Events.what: Fashion Week coverage: runway walks, backstage touch-ups, designer show recaps, models posing with 9to5 products. Mostly Lakmē filming the show, with Aneet Padda on the runway for the big ones.
slices:Events.why: Aneet bowing with Amit Aggarwal in confetti is the peak, and the grand finale carousel with her dancing follows. The bottom is the same-looking pile: models against white backdrops, front-row powder touch-ups, runway recaps nobody is named in.

slices:Skincare.what: The Ice Ceramide Lip I.V. launch week: Aneet Padda with the metallic applicator, then a model with ice cubes and raspberries, a dry versus hydrated lip split, an ingredients caption.
slices:Skincare.why: Aneet introducing the balm herself is the whole story. The follow-ups, the model with ice cubes, the split-lip carousel and the ceramide explainer, show the same product with no famous face and land near or under the usual post.

slices:Teasers.what: Festive launch teases before the reset range: a glitter and sweets collage, a 9to5-over-5to9 skit, a meme reel, a countdown. Mostly captions and nobody on screen.
slices:Teasers.why: Comments run ahead of likes here: the guess-what-it-is posts get people replying more than liking. The glitter and sweets collage carousel is the only one clearly above its usual likes, the two Fri 2 Oct reels sit at half.

slices:Eyes & base.what: The Hya Glam reset launch: strobe cream, liner and eyeshadow duo and face palette, shown as product shots, graphics and backstage model clips. Mostly caption-only, rarely anyone famous.
slices:Eyes & base.why: One post stands out: the 27 Oct Hya Glam reel with a famous face. The product-shot launch reels sit a little above the usual post. Backstage model clips and the strobe before-and-after fall to a third or less.

sides:A famous face on screen|Events|top.what: Fashion Week posts with a known face: Aneet Padda walking and bowing with Amit Aggarwal, dancing at the grand finale, and creator Ankush Bahuguna in the booth or touching up.
sides:A famous face on screen|Events|top.why: The Aneet runway reels carry it. The weak ones are Ankush's booth chat and a front-row powder touch-up, where the face is a guest, not the show. The 63× caption-only reel is the one big hit without a face.

sides:A famous face on screen||top.what: Posts with a known face: Aneet Padda as Skin Goals Officer, on the runway, with the Lip I.V. balm, and Aditya Madiraju eating Delhi snacks while applying a lip product.
sides:A famous face on screen||top.why: The strong ones give the face a job: skin officer, runway bow, balm launch, snack vlog. The weak ones are Ankush Bahuguna sitting in a booth or touching up in an elevator. Without one, the best is a caption-only reel.

sides:Tags another account|Events|top.what: Fashion Week posts tagging a designer or partner: the grand finale carousel with Aneet and Amit Aggarwal, the schedule announcement, a six-slide runway makeup breakdown, the opening show with Tira.
sides:Tags another account|Events|top.why: Tagged posts are mostly carousels. The finale, the schedule and the six-slide product breakdown do well. The tagged runway recap reels barely move. The two biggest reels are on the without side.

sides:Three or more on screen|Events|top.what: Fashion Week carousels with a crowd in frame: Aneet and models at the finale, Manish Malhotra's show with Sara Ali Khan and Ayushmann Khurrana, a six-slide look-by-look makeup breakdown.
sides:Three or more on screen|Events|top.why: All carousels. The strong ones put a star in the crowd or break down each look. The backstage crowd carousels, 'fresh faces, final fixes' and 'glam was everywhere', sit under the usual post. The two biggest reels are without it.

sides:Posed photo (style)|Events|top.what: Backstage portraits at Fashion Week: models posing against white walls with 9to5 products, winged liner portraits, last-touch-up clips, mostly filmed as still-style shots.
sides:Posed photo (style)|Events|top.why: Most land at a third or less of the usual post, with a couple above. Without it are the runway bows, the finale and the lounge tour, all with motion or a star.

sides:Studio / set|Events|top.what: Fashion Week posts shot on a set or against a plain backdrop: models in a line holding 9to5 products, backstage touch-ups, last-look portraits, a skit about a friend's runway debut.
sides:Studio / set|Events|top.why: A flat backdrop, one model, a product held up. Without it: the live runway, Aneet's bow, the finale, the lounge tour. Nothing on a set gets near those.

followers:t10.why: Follows after the best posts are uneven: the 17 Oct runway makeup breakdown carousel and a caption-only reel brought the most. Aneet's bow and the Lip I.V. launch brought fewer. The skin officer reel barely added any.

followers:2026-10-17.what: Saturday 17 Oct: a Hya Glam lounge hand tour, Aneet's soft glam studio reel, a six-slide runway makeup breakdown, plus model posing and designer recaps.
followers:2026-10-17.why: No single post owns a day's follows. The ones that fit are product-led: the lounge tour, Aneet's Hya Glam reel, the look-by-look carousel. White-backdrop model posts ran beside them.

followers:2026-10-07.what: Three Hya Glam reset posts, 6 and 7 Oct: caption-led product carousels with nobody on screen and a designed-graphic reel with three people.
followers:2026-10-07.why: Nothing in them explains a loss that size. They look like the rest of the reset week: caption-led product posts, nobody famous.

formats:Reels.what: Aneet Padda's runway bow, the Lip I.V. launch, the skin officer bit, Aditya's snack vlog, and a lot of white-backdrop model posing and front-row touch-ups.
formats:Reels.why: Reels hold the biggest hits and the worst floor. The top reels all have Aneet or a creator doing something. The bottom are models against white backdrops and runway recaps with nobody to follow.

formats:Carousels.what: Runway photo sets, look-by-look makeup breakdowns, the schedule announcement, backstage portraits, festive product graphics for the reset range.
formats:Carousels.why: The best carousels are tied to a big show: the finale with Aneet, the AM.IT runway, the Manish Malhotra set. The weak ones are the backstage portraits and Hya Glam product carousels with no face and no show.

formats:Photos.what: One single photo: a mock-tweet meme of five Lakmē products buckled into a car passenger seat.
formats:Photos.why: Only one photo in the 100, so there is nothing to compare it against. It sits well under the usual post.

frequency:peak.what: Every Fashion Week show, covered: runway recaps, backstage touch-ups, models on white with Hya Glam, front-row guests, the Hya Glam lounge, plus six eyes & base posts.
frequency:peak.why: The posts with a star or a show to follow held up. The pile of near-identical backstage shots is what sank.

frequency:after.what: Monday's finale (Aneet's walk, the AM.IT set, the look breakdown), then Aditya's snack reel, the Ice Ceramide launch, Ankush in the booth, the strobe demo and the balm on a model.
frequency:after.why: Fewer posts, and more of them had a face with a job. That's the whole jump from 0.9× to 2×.

frequency:day.what: Saturday at Fashion Week: runway recaps from five shows, models on white with Hya Glam, front-row touch-ups, the Hya Glam lounge tour, Aneet's soft glam reel and a six-slide look breakdown.
frequency:day.why: The lounge tour, Aneet's reel and the breakdown did well. The rest was the same backstage shot over and over.

voice.say: Fashion Week ended, the posting calmed down, and Aneet did the heavy lifting: her runway walk and her balm launch took 70% of the week's likes.
voice.strategy: Lakmē spent October on Fashion Week: 56 event posts in a month. The posts that mattered were Aneet's: the runway walk, the balm launch, Skin Goals Officer. The rest kept the feed full.

split.line: Aneet's balm launch tops this wall at 106×. An eyes & base reel from 18 Oct is the floor, at 0.3×.

slices.hl: Fashion Week was **56 posts**. Aneet's walk alone took **a third** of their likes.
slices.sub: Last week: seven event posts, five Aneet and creator posts, two eyes & base, two skincare.

streaks.hl: Fashion Week ran cold for **three days** of backstage posts, then hot the moment Aneet walked.
streaks.sub: A run is six or more posts in a row over its usual, or under it.

frequency.hl: Lakmē posts about **17** a week, until there's a show. Fashion Week took it to **53**, and the drop to 16 after was the good kind.
frequency.sub: How many it posts in a day barely changes how each one does.

views.hl: The Manish Malhotra reels played **1.8×** its other reels. Studio shots at the show played **0.6×** the rest of it.
views.sub: Only 25 reels have plays, all from Fashion Week on. A usual reel’s plays come to 2% of its follower count.

likes.hl: Aneet posts get **13×** the likes of everything else. At the show, a studio shot got **0.3×** the rest of the show.
likes.sub: Faces with a job carry it. Amit Aggarwal’s posts did 7.9×, led by Aneet on his runway.

comments.hl: Aneet gets them talking too: **10×** the comments. Ankush’s four posts get **0.3×**.
comments.sub: At the last read, famous faces at events drew 0.4× the comments of the rest. Fashion Week took that to 3.8×.

follows.hl: Its follows ride the calendar. Its **four best days** in October were all Fashion Week.
follows.sub: Posts someone else filmed, most of them the show, ran +5,193 against its pace. The famous faces that win its likes ran −285.

shifts.hl: Since 16 Oct it gains **881** followers a day. Before that it was losing **536** a day.
shifts.sub: The teasers stopped, and Aneet and the creators went from 3 posts to 8. The typical post’s comments fell from 1.3× to 0.5×.

slices:Aneet & collabs.line: Aneet with a job to do is Lakmē's best post, every time. Creators are a coin flip.
slices:Aneet & collabs.aside: There's less of her than in summer: 18 posts in June, 9 in October.

slices:Lips & cheeks.line: Lips & cheeks used to be half the feed, 51% of August. October had two posts.
slices:Lips & cheeks.aside: Both went up on 9 Oct for the festive reset.

slices:Events.line: Fashion Week, every show of it. The ones with Aneet or a show to follow did fine; the white-backdrop model shots were the floor.
slices:Events.aside: Comments are the giveaway: 0.5× its usual. Nobody talks back to a backstage portrait.

slices:Skincare.line: One launch, four posts. Aneet's reel carried it; the three follow-ups without her didn't beat an ordinary Lakmē post.
slices:Skincare.aside: Skincare was about a fifth of the feed from April to September. Four posts this month.

slices:Teasers.line: Guess-what's-coming posts before the reset launch. Likes stayed flat; comments ran 3× its usual.
slices:Teasers.aside: People like guessing. All six went up between 1 and 4 Oct.

slices:Eyes & base.line: The Hya Glam reset, mostly product shots and models on white. One broke out: the 27 Oct reel with a famous face, 14×.
slices:Eyes & base.aside: Twenty posts in October, after none in July and August.

sides:A famous face on screen|Events|top.line: At Fashion Week, a star on the runway beat everything backstage.
sides:A famous face on screen|Events|top.aside: Aneet's bow with Amit Aggarwal leads. Front-row touch-ups sit at the bottom, famous faces or not.

sides:A famous face on screen||top.line: A face works when it has a job: Aneet launching a balm, bowing on the runway, playing Skin Goals Officer.
sides:A famous face on screen||top.aside: Ankush answering chits in the booth did 0.5×.

sides:Tags another account|Events|top.line: Fashion Week posts that tag a designer or partner did better: the finale with Amit Aggarwal, the schedule, the look-by-look breakdown.
sides:Tags another account|Events|top.aside: Mostly carousels, and mostly the shows people came for.

sides:Three or more on screen|Events|top.line: A crowd works when there's a star in it: Aneet at the finale, Sara Ali Khan at Manish Malhotra.
sides:Three or more on screen|Events|top.aside: Backstage crowds, 'fresh faces, final fixes', sit under its usual.

sides:Posed photo (style)|Events|top.line: Backstage portraits are the floor: a model against a white wall, holding a product.
sides:Posed photo (style)|Events|top.aside: Nobody comments on them: 0.3× the comments of the rest of Fashion Week.

sides:Studio / set|Events|top.line: Same story on a set: one model, a flat backdrop, a product held up.
sides:Studio / set|Events|top.aside: Everything that worked at Fashion Week happened on the runway.

frequency:peak.line: Fashion Week: 45 of the 53 posts. Each did about its usual, and that many add up.
frequency:peak.aside: 64K likes that week, about seven times a usual week's.

frequency:after.aside: A third of the posts and nearly twice the likes. Followers cooled to +6,780, still above its usual pace.

frequency:day.line: It covered every show like a live blog. Ten of the fifteen came in under its usual.
frequency:day.aside: The keepers: the Hya Glam lounge tour, Aneet's soft glam reel, the look-by-look breakdown.

followers:2026-10-17.line: Its best follower day came on the day its posts did worst.
followers:2026-10-17.aside: +3,184, when a usual day brings +460. The show brought people in.

followers:2026-10-07.line: Mid-launch, it lost 3,469 followers in a day. Nothing it posted explains that.
followers:2026-10-07.aside: Three ordinary Hya Glam reset posts went up around it.

DepkU_StKjC.so: Everything else Lakmē posted that week was backstage. This was the show.

since.line: The show ended and people started talking again. Comments went from 0.5× to 1.8×.
since.why: Likes more than doubled, from 0.9× to 2×. Follows cooled from +8,381 to +6,780, still above a usual week.
